metadata.summary: The customer inquired about the Breakfast Bundle and apple juice but could not find apple-related items on the menu.

messages.text: Hello Jitin Welcome to manhattan bagel It is great to see you again What would you like to order?

Okay, a Breakfast Bundle. Let me get that started for you. First, I need to choose 13 bagels for the bundle. We have a wide variety to choose from, including Plain, Everything, Blueberry, Chocolate Chip, Cinnamon Raisin, and many more. Would you like to hear some options to start with?
Can you please tell me all the bigger types? And I want all 13 sorry. All five as blueberry, five as multigrain, and, rest three as vanilla.
I don't see a Vanilla bagel on our menu. Let me share some options: Plain, Everything, Blueberry, Chocolate Chip, Cinnamon Raisin, Egg, Garlic, French

We don't have apple juice on our menu. Let me share some options: Tropicana OJ, Fresh Squeezed Orange Juice, and we also have a variety of other beverages like coffee, tea, and lemonade. Would you like to hear more options or choose from these?
No. I want apple juice only.
I'm sorry, but we don't have apple juice available on our menu. Our juice options include Tropicana OJ and Fresh Squeezed Orange Juice. Would you like to choose one of these instead?
You don't have anything related to Apple?
